revision_reason: The T08 checkpoint used value_tolerance=0.05 for expected_y=0.05, so y=0 was accepted at 100% relative error. T09 separates threshold-level and flatness checks, requires an independently frozen tolerance basis, and uses a value tolerance of 0.005 (10% of the reference) fixed from the source panel's tick spacing before the audit. The T08 file and its saved regression output are preserved unchanged as historical evidence.

checkpoints.text: Project-curated plot check: the alpha series stays at its 0.05 reference level (value tolerance +/-0.005, 10% of the reference) and remains flat within 0.002 (0.2% of the 0-1 axis span). This is not an author-confirmed claim.

scientific.tolerance_basis: Value tolerance is 10% of the 0.05 reference level; flatness tolerance is 0.2% of the 0-1 y-axis span. Both were fixed from the source panel's tick spacing before the revised audit and are not chosen from the A/B observations.

checkpoints.provenance_note: Project-curated threshold and flatness check, verified against the source panel before freezing. It is not the product owner's item-by-item confirmation and must remain review_required. The T08 checkpoint and regression JSON are superseded but not overwritten.
